author: Myv
body:
Hello, I am back to present you with my new project, Lunar.

This map is a mini sub base on the moon, with a couple of hidden areas.

Information

Makers: Myv and Raikkou
Helpers: _iMan

First to: 100
Teams: 12v12
Time Limit: 10 minutes
Team Colours: Lime and Green (this may change as they are similar)

Items at Spawn: Stone Sword, 2 Golden Apples, Bow, 16 Arrows, 32 stone bricks, 32 glass, 32 steak. 

Download: Coming very soon!
XML: Will be done after download.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/Djnb0

Thank you!
